newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Mixed deals struck in UK equity options.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Mixed deals struck in UK equity options.

text.p: With the London stock market scaling new peaks on Friday, traders had the opportunity to undertake a mix of trades in the equity options market, dealers said.
In British Telecommunications one trader, expecting the underlying shares to fall back, bought 1,500 August 460 calls at 34p.

A view implied by another deal was that the shares will fail to rally by next Wednesday -- the May options expiry date. One trader sold 1,000 May 460 calls at 3p in order to capture time value premium.
BT shares closed up two pence at 454-1/2.
Over in tobacco-to-insurance group B.A.T Industries the main deal was from a buyer of 1,300 July 600 calls at 17p and 18p. The shares added nine pence to 558-1/2p.
A volatility trade was the chief event in aeroengine manufacturer Rolls Royce, with the purchase of 1,000 May 240 puts and calls at 1/2p and 12-1/2p each.
Dealers believed this may have a closing deal ahead of next week's stock options expiry and the shares closed down 1-1/2p at 247-1/2p.

Over in index options the bulk of trading was related to today's expiry of the May FTSE 100 contracts. Hectic trading in the May 4700 calls resulted in a spike up in the futures and cash markets this morning as traders scrambled to close positions by the 0930 GMT deadline. Around 6,500 lots were traded in that series.
Cash FTSE closed up 12.7 points at 4693.9.
